title: Integrate INT8 weight-only profile registry with nightly drift validator and FP8 fallback paths
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Wire the new weight-only INT8 profile registry into the CI/nightly validation pipeline and add a drift detector that promotes or flags profile candidates. The registry will become the canonical source for serving-time profile selection (hosted and dedicated). This work covers: 1) ingestion hooks for GPTQ and AWQ calibration outputs, 2) an automated nightly validator that runs a representative prompt corpus across newly added profiles and compares accuracy/regression metrics, 3) an FP8 fallback route when INT8 profiles fail quality thresholds for a model/tenant, and 4) observability (per-profile histograms of token mismatch, latency delta, and cost delta). This ticket focuses on integration and regression safety (not calibration algorithm changes).
acceptance_criteria: Profile registry accepts GPTQ and AWQ artifacts and stores a normalized metadata blob for each weight-only profile
Nightly validation job runs for new profiles and computes quality delta (perplexity, rouge, embedding-similarity) against the golden baseline within 8 hours of profile upload
Profiles that exceed configured thresholds are marked "rejected" and do not roll out to canary buckets; approved profiles can be referenced by model routing policies
FP8 fallback is exercised end-to-end: when INT8 profile fails for a particular input distribution in canary, traffic is rerouted to an FP8 variant automatically according to policy
Dashboard shows per-profile quality signals and a changelog link to the originating PR/commit
Regression tests (smoke + accuracy) are added to the CI harness and pass on PRs that touch registry ingestion or validator code
steps: Define normalized profile schema and metadata fields (quantization params, calibration dataset hash, seed, model-architecture, sequence-length buckets)
Add ingestion endpoint to registry service and a small validator that verifies artifact integrity and metadata completeness
Create nightly validator job that runs a lightweight representative prompt set and computes the quality metrics; store results to S3 and emit events to console-observability
Implement policy layer: accept / reject rules + canary rollout selectors + FP8 fallback route when quality delta > threshold
Wire console dashboards and tracing to show profile events, validation metrics, and rollback controls
Add CI unit tests and a smoke regression that runs on a small set of models and a single quantized profile sample
Run a focused canary with a single internal tenant and monitor for 72 hours, capture any drift and revert plan
